facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.create_class_aware_sampler: create a ClassAwareSampler instance from a data source with labels for balanced class sampling
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.create_random_cycle_iterator: create a RandomCycleIter to cycle through data with optional shuffling between epochs

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.create_ClassPrioritySampler: create a ClassPrioritySampler instance with a dataset, balance_scale, fixed_scale, and lam parameters for class-balanced sampling

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.update_weights_ClassPrioritySampler: update the priority weights of a ClassPrioritySampler using batch indices, weights, and labels during training

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.create_priority_tree: create a PriorityTree with a given capacity and optional fixed weights for priority sampling
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.update_priority_tree_leaf: update a single leaf node priority in the PriorityTree and propagate changes up the tree
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.sample_from_priority_tree: sample a data index from the PriorityTree by traversing from root to leaf with a random value
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.create_mixed_prioritized_sampler: create a MixedPrioritizedSampler for a dataset combining balanced class weights with priority-based sampling
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.reset_sampler_weights: reset the sampler weights for a given epoch using linear, periodic, or cosine shifting strategies

facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.load_data_dataloader: create a PyTorch DataLoader from a dataset text file with configurable batch size and sampler
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.load_data_openset: load a concatenated dataset combining standard and open-set test images for evaluation
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.get_data_transform_train: build a torchvision transform pipeline with random crop, flip, and color jitter for training
facebookresearch_classifier-balancing/da.get_data_transform_test: build a torchvision transform pipeline with resize and center crop for validation or testing
